Amazon cloud infrastructure in Bahrain, UAE damaged after Iran attacks

Amazon Web Services (AWS) has confirmed that it cannot restore access to certain cloud facilities and data centres in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and Bahrain following attacks carried out by Iran earlier this year.
